eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant women
* Singleton pregnancy (on USG)
* Gestational age ≥ 24-weeks (on LMP method) and
* Past medical history of pre-eclampsia (on medical record)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pre-existing chronic hypertension
* Cardiac diseases (congenital or acquired)
* Renal disease
* Thyrotoxicosis (on history and medical record) and
* Intra-uterine death of the fetus.

identificationModule.briefTitle: Vitamin D Therapy to Prevent Recurrent Preeclampsia in High-Risk Pregnancies
